name: marketing-06
title: AI product landing page
description: A Tallyhand landing page, section by section: a floating navbar, a hero whose last word turns over beside an agent run that ticks through a month-end close, a band where a planner hands work to three agents, five feature tiles that play in turn, figures under a period switch, pricing in one sentence whose number you type or drag, quotes with their results, searchable questions with copyable links and a closing call to action beside a queue that clears, over one footer.
